title: A reading preview is never requested before it exists

cause.studio: isPreviewItem admits an item in state probed, planned, reading or preparing as soon as it has a source and a streamed profile job. ReadPreviews.sync read the route at once for every new such item, so a file still being probed or queued was asked about before any reader part existed.
cause.server: readIntakeReadPreview answers 404 'The file has no published reader parts yet.' in two places: no streaming-vector operation row for the item yet, and status.nextPublishIndex of 0. Both are correct answers: the route has nothing to send.
cause.itemStatesIt: IntakeItem.partsDone is the reader's next_publish_index while reading (intakeLargeNumbers), the same count the route checks; partsPlanned is the reader's sealed chunk count once it is sealed. Both come with the batch read the Studio already polls.
cause.notARace: Once the item states partsDone above 0 the server has a published part, so the status/storage race does not apply. Not a missing object: the files were read normally and the journey passed 8 of 8.
cause.whyNoErrorShown: The 404 was swallowed (failure null) and asked again every 2 s, so the officer saw nothing, but the browser recorded a failed request.

fix.risk: low: Studio only, display only, no contract change, nothing stored or decided
change: readPreview.ts: hasReadPart(item) is true when partsDone > 0 or partsPlanned is not null; ReadPreviews.sync starts following an item only then, so no request is made before the item states a published part.

readPreview.ts: a 404 is no longer swallowed. For an item that states a published part it is a real missing preview, so the line shows the route's error and the file is asked again after the poll delay, as before for server faults; a later good answer clears it.
fix.unchanged: Server, contracts, openapi, other Studio modules; a follow that exists keeps going through any later item state until its first package reaches the map.
fix.knownEffect: An item first seen in the draft phase with partsDone 0 and partsPlanned null (reader sealed, no package published yet) gets no provisional preview. Its packages reach the map next.

added: asks for nothing until the item states a published reader part, then loads the preview (no request, nothing published, no error while partsDone is 0; one request from after=-1 when it is 1)
asks once the reader has sealed its parts, whatever the parts done (partsPlanned set, partsDone 0)
shows the error for a missing preview the item says exists, and reads on (404 shows the route's words, the next poll loads the preview and the error clears)
tests.fixtureChange: the default test item states partsDone 1
